problem_and_intended_users_defined.rationale: P-056 gives maintainers and contributors a bounded, reproducible way to run established REUSE compliance checks and retain privacy-minimized evidence without turning a tooling result into legal or license-compatibility advice.

public_repository_or_distribution_surfac.rationale: The product is public as source, a reusable composite GitHub Action and the governed non-draft v0.11.1 release.

explicit_open_source_license.rationale: The public repository carries the MIT License covering the DAIS P-056 implementation; the wrapped upstream REUSE ecosystem retains its own licensing and authority boundary.

complete_readme.rationale: Documentation covers purpose, CLI/Action use, evidence semantics, exact upstream version, beginner interpretation, architecture, privacy/security, accessibility/localization, recovery, release scope, the v0.11.0 fail-honest defect and v0.11.1 permanent repair.

beginner_start_here_path.rationale: A dedicated beginner path explains what REUSE compliance means in this product, how to run it and the legal/compatibility claims it deliberately does not make.

engineering_or_architecture_documentatio.rationale: The engineering path documents a read-only wrapper around pinned REUSE 6.2.0, bounded semantic projection, deterministic semantic evidence identity, separate raw-run identity, path/output controls and hard-false legal/compatibility claims.

reproducible_installation_or_use_instruc.rationale: Consumers can invoke the exact released @v0.11.1 Action. The Action pins REUSE 6.2.0, verifies its observed version, records a SHA-256 of the resolved sorted pip environment, and released-ref acceptance exercises that public interface repeatedly.

safety_scope_and_limitations.rationale: The product explicitly excludes legal advice, redistribution permission, license compatibility, dependency-license safety, third-party-notice completeness, repository-security guarantees, distribution approval and a fully hash-locked transitive dependency closure.

recovery_or_rollback_guidance_for_mutati.rationale: P-056 does not mutate the audited repository. Recovery is deletion of runner-temporary/output evidence and rerun; any later maintainer licensing edits remain ordinary separately reviewed Git changes with normal revert semantics.

tests_and_ci.rationale: Adversarial and hosted tests cover safe roots/outputs, real REUSE compliant/noncompliant fixtures, privacy minimization, exact tool/spec versions, semantic determinism under differently serialized upstream JSON, English/Spanish truth consistency, exact-source governed publication and released-ref public-consumer immutability.

security_and_privacy_review.rationale: The review covers read-only audit behavior, bounded path/output handling, no product network request, no repository mutation, privacy-minimized semantic evidence, runner-temporary raw REUSE output, and explicit refusal to publish path/copyright/license-detail raw evidence blindly.

accessibility_review.rationale: The product interface is text-first JSON/Markdown with explicit status labels and no color-only meaning. This is an applicability review, not WCAG conformance or human assistive-technology certification.

multilingual_path_considered.rationale: English and Spanish guides are executable product modes over one language-neutral deterministic technical report. Released-ref acceptance proves identical semantic report SHA-256 across EN, repeated EN and ES while the guides remain localized.

evidence: GitHub job 95159867056 — released @v0.11.1 against AntonyMD7/learning-git at 01723a1825113de08810193f37e8047d978433c2
real_world_acceptance_test.rationale: The exact public @v0.11.1 Action was consumed three times against a pinned real public learning-git checkout. It returned the same truthful REUSE_NONCOMPLIANT state and identical deterministic semantic report SHA-256 9b1a820a49ff77f18b514d8ce424849e18454584e210d47081b41ac8ed72a593 across EN/EN-repeat/ES, while exact raw REUSE hashes differed per execution as intended and the consumer tree/README remained unchanged.

evidence_retained.rationale: Exact-main source acceptance, release-plan, publication and released-ref public-consumer evidence are retained with artifact IDs/digests; the permanent completion record preserves their meaning, the v0.11.0 failure history and the non-claims.

version_tag_or_release_published.rationale: Public non-draft/non-prerelease v0.11.1 was published on 2026-08-16 and independently verified to target exact reviewed product source a7b6dfa494e3fac6d7d20cab651b47f686e92495.

known_limitations_documented.rationale: REUSE-tool scope, no legal/compatibility/distribution verdict, privacy boundary for raw output, no fully hash-locked transitive closure, no WCAG/human multilingual acceptance claim and no guarantee that one clean check establishes future repository compliance are explicit.

contribution_and_issue_paths.rationale: General contribution guidance and a dedicated privacy-safe P-056 support/reproduction path exist on the public default branch.

canonical_handover_or_build_record_updat.rationale: The final completion record binds the upstream-adoption boundary, architecture, v0.11.0 fail-honest defect, v0.11.1 repair, exact release source, governed publication, real public released-ref acceptance, retained evidence, security/privacy/accessibility review, recovery and limitations.
